purpose: Test seed hypothesis claim that no FATP-directed agent has been tested in human MASLD.

studies.title: Therapeutic Omegas for Triglyceride Suppression
studies.relevance: NOT a FATP2-directed agent; omega-3 triglyceride study, term-match only

fatty acid transport protein + (steatohe.assessment: All matched by generic text; interventions are exercise, diet, orlistat, liraglutide/semaglutide (GLP-1), FMT, gemcabene, growth hormone, chrononutrition. NONE is a FATP5/FATP2-directed agent.

conclusion: As of 2026-10-07, ClinicalTrials.gov contains NO interventional trial of any FATP5/FATP2-directed agent (including lipofermata) in MASLD/NASH/NAFLD. This confirms the seed hypothesis's stated therapeutic-absence gap.
limitations: ClinicalTrials.gov is US-centric; EudraCT/WHO ICTRP/jRCT not separately queried. A compound could exist under an undisclosed code name. Negative is scoped to these exact queries.
